author: FrostByte
resume_author: If you rescue a damsel in distress, all you will get is a distressed damsel.
text_post: MGTOW is about sovereignty. Dream being the best you, you can be?? Do it, don’t dream it. You have the power.

I agree with you 100%. You would be shocked at how much you can accomplish when you leave women alone, and focus on the goals that you have set for yourself. The women will always be there, they aren’t going anywhere. Your goals are not going to wait for you, you gotta be able to grab life by the throat and own your life. Don’t wait to be given something. You would be surprised at how far hard work and little faith can get you. There were times where I had classes that I didn’t know how I was going to get out of, but faith and hardwork brought me through. And now I’m working on a Master’s. The youngest kid in the family, and already am the only male to graduate college. Fellas write down your goals and put them somewhere that you walk by everyday. And everyday I want to look at those goals as you go about your day. Become obsessed with accomplishing those goals. Everything that you do, you do it for those goals. And when times get hard, look at those goals to remember why your doing the things you are doing. Look at those goals to remember how far you’ve come. It’s not about where you start, it’s about where you finish. Life is a marathon, don’t sprint.
